title: Researchers develop full-color night vision goggles using a dual-emitter OLED upconverter device
content: Researchers from the Beijing Institute of Technology (BIT) have developed an infrared-to-visible upconversion device (night goggles) that stacks a mercury telluride (HgTe) colloidal quantum dot photodetector directly underneath a dual-emissive-layer OLED.
